meta.title: Ondra Persona Evolution
meta.description: She ships with a baseline; her character is something the two of you grow. Only numbers move here, never the setting text: the same persona gradually becomes a little harder to please and a little steadier. Every shift records what pushed it, so it stays explainable and reversible one entry at a time, and the line for what counts as a good mood drifts upward with time together - sixty used to be enough, later it takes eighty.
